source_checks: All 16 independent finite-image expected selections, uniqueness/count/empty premises and learned-row requirements passed before native execution. Canonical template absences only cover declared literal/generic keys.

findings.answer_form_boundary: The intended single-filter control also declined on both artifacts. Seven candidate positive cases decline answer_form; they remain misses, not changed expectations.

report.scope: Predeclared targeted exact-segment/single-nested cohort over one finite pinned KB. Independently sourced expectations; no random coverage, shipped specialist-panel, fleet gain, full Reader7 or current-world completeness claim.

selection.method: Before native runs, inspect exact learned wording and enumerate cities with an official-website row, positive integral population row, direct city membership and a university location/headquarters edge. Choose the first three distinct eligible city IDs in SQLite text order: Q10566 Saskatoon, Q10686 Belfast, Q10690 Cardiff; use their least observed population value. Add Q23154 Bristol as an explicitly hand-selected familiar source anchor for a six-person ambiguity/count pair. Compose/reorder already learned exact pieces, and add unchanged wording and explicit contradictory/empty negatives. No native result or validation gold used for selection.
selection.coverage_premise: Every expected selection, uniqueness, ambiguity and count quantifies over all entity/parent/attribute/forward-edge rows in the named immutable image. The image is the complete finite test universe; these aggregates and empty cases do not assert the outside world is closed or current.
selection.canonical_absence_boundary: Exact canonical literal-key and generic A-slot whole/fragment templates below have zero rows in this image. This does not prove absence of every alternative lexical reading; the fixed old artifact comparison determines actual gains.
selection.negative_construction: Use source population plus one, mix two different source cities' website/population, and ask for a stored relation with no matching typed targets. Decline-empty expectations follow the reader's fragment nonempty admission rule, not a claim of a universal zero.

report.timing_boundary: One control and one candidate fresh process, fixed order, warm filesystem; descriptive only, not a matched performance experiment.
report.coverage_boundary: Targeted construction from learned wording and source rows; no random/fleet/panel or full Reader7 claim. Primary canonical template absence does not exclude all lexical alternative readings.
